title: Nutty Middle Eastern Lamb Kebabs
description: A flavorful and crumbly Middle Eastern dish featuring lamb, speculaas spice mix, and lardons, perfect for meal prep. This umami-rich recipe is a Mediterranean-friendly delight.
instructions: Preheat the grill to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together speculaas spice mix, salt, and black pepper.
Add the lamb cubes to the bowl and toss to coat with the spice mixture.
Thread the lamb cubes onto skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
Brush the lamb with olive oil and grill for 10-12 minutes, or until cooked through.
While the lamb is cooking, mix together lemon juice, parsley, and mint in a small bowl.
Once the lamb is done, brush with the lemon juice mixture and top with crumbled lardons.
Let cool completely before refrigerating or freezing for meal prep.
